crossRefs.note: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your…
My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the…
I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over…
I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do…
Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”
Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”
Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his…
Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have…
But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and…
For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

translations.web: Now in return, I speak as to my children: you also open your hearts.
translations.bsb: As a fair exchange—I speak as to my children—open wide your hearts also.
translations.kjv: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ➔ ye also enlarged.
translations.asv: Now for a recompense in like kind (I speak as unto my children), be ye also enlarged.
